name: Space Breakers
source:
Hop aboard the Rusty Clover as it travels the galaxy in search of potential riches and mystery! 

Be part of a colorful cast of misfit aliens as you search through a derelict space station.

[From [url=https://silverteeshirt.itch.io/space-breakers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
登上“锈苜蓿号”，穿梭银河，寻找潜在的财富与谜团！

加入一群个性鲜明、与众不同的外星伙伴，探索一座废弃空间站。

[摘自[url=https://silverteeshirt.itch.io/space-breakers]itch.io[/url]]
